name: Revenue MTD with no date filter is this month to today, branch 1
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Revenue], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "MTD"))
sql: select sum(revenue_amount) from gold.ssas_fact_charge_line where branch_key = 1 and delivery_date_key >= toYYYYMMDD(toStartOfMonth(today())) and delivery_date_key <= toYYYYMMDD(today())

name: Revenue YTD with no date filter is this year to today, branch 1
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Revenue], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "YTD"))
sql: select sum(revenue_amount) from gold.ssas_fact_charge_line where branch_key = 1 and delivery_date_key >= toYYYYMMDD(toStartOfYear(today())) and delivery_date_key <= toYYYYMMDD(today())

name: Revenue Rolling 12M with no date filter is the 12 months to today, branch 1
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Revenue], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "Rolling 12M"))
sql: select sum(revenue_amount) from gold.ssas_fact_charge_line where branch_key = 1 and delivery_date_key > toYYYYMMDD(addMonths(today(), -12)) and delivery_date_key <= toYYYYMMDD(today())

name: Revenue PY of the current year is last year to the same day, branch 1
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Revenue], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Date'[Year] = YEAR ( TODAY () ), 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "PY"))
sql: select sum(revenue_amount) from gold.ssas_fact_charge_line where branch_key = 1 and delivery_date_key >= toYYYYMMDD(toStartOfYear(addYears(today(), -1))) and delivery_date_key <= toYYYYMMDD(addYears(today(), -1))

name: Revenue MTD of the current year is this month to today, branch 1
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Revenue], Branch[Branch Key] = 1, 'Date'[Year] = YEAR ( TODAY () ), 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "MTD"))
sql: select sum(revenue_amount) from gold.ssas_fact_charge_line where branch_key = 1 and delivery_date_key >= toYYYYMMDD(toStartOfMonth(today())) and delivery_date_key <= toYYYYMMDD(today())

name: Current User under YoY Δ returns the user, not an error
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", INT(LEN(CALCULATE([Current User], 'Time Calculation'[Time Calculation] = "YoY Δ")) > 0))
